balls.text: Short and wide and David can only pull it out to deep midwicket. David is well short of his ground though while trying to take the second and Jurel has all the time in the world to take the bails off
On a length around off, Jitesh can't time it as he looks to swing it away and the ball rolls through midwicket
Pulled away in the gap! 200 crossed for RCB Slower bouncer outside off and Jitesh swivels and hits this in the gap between deep square leg and deep midwicket
Yorker outside off, David jams his face down with an open face and gets it out to point. They get a single. That was bowled at 146kph
Jitesh is beaten by the pace of that very well-directed bumper around off. Looks to pull and takes a blow on the helmet. They are able to sneak the leg bye
Yorker outside off, Jites his well across his stumps and ends up just digging it back out to Archer's right. Another dot ball from the pacer
Yorker outside off, dug back out to the bowler's left
Hammered over cover and just over a leaping fielder! Full outside off and David takes it on inside out. Nitish Rana was at full stretch, but David got enough elevation on that

Slower bouncer outside off, David waits on it to cut, but is beaten by the lack of pace. David reviews for wide not given. David is on his toes looking to ramp this over as the ball goes by, so he could have a case here. That's deemed to be going above David's head. Bonus run for RCB, and an extra ball too

Another attempted scoop goes wrong, and this time it's just the single for RCB. Jitesh goes across his stumps and looks to reverse-scoop this wide length ball. Loops up over the inside edge but lands safe
Slapped away in the gap! Short and wide, Jitesh moves across and swats this over cover. One bounce and four
On a length, but too wide. He'll have to rebowl that as well

In no man's land! Bumped in short and wide, David looks to swat it away and the ball goes high in the air. But it drops in the vacant midwicket region. Sandeep Sharma running to his right can't get there
Yorker outside off, Jitesh goes across to sweep and misses. They sneak the leg bye as the ball rolls to Jitesh's left off his pad
Short and wide, Jitesh looks to cut it away but it's too far for him. And rightly called wide
Short outside off, David pulls it in front of square leg. Hasaranga collects, even as the two boundary riders almost collide
Cut away hard! Poor fielding at backward point. Low full toss outside off and David opens the face and hits this hard, but Shubham Dubey lets this go through his legs
Very full outside off, David looks to swing this away leg side but can't get under it. Dug out towards deep midwicket's left and they do well to take two
Length ball, pace off, angled across. Jitesh looks to cut and gets an underedge towards short third

Not sure how much in control of that Jitesh was, but he gets a boundary! Shapes up early for the scoop, Farooqi bowls it on a length angled across him, Jitesh goes through with the shot and it goes off the inside edge but well over short fine!
Short outside leg and angled across David, who stands tall and pulls it along the ground to deep midwicket
Risky shot but it pays dividend! Short outside off, Jitesh slashes at it close to his body and the ball flies between keeper and short third!
Edged and taken! Back of length outside off, cross-seam, Patidar slashes at it and Jurel does the rest as the ball kisses the outside edge
Short outside off, he plays almost a tennis-forehand style shot to mid-off's right
On a length around off, punched towards long-on for a single
On a length outside off, punched off the backfoot to cover

Spooned to mid-off and Rana holds on after a juggling act! This is a slower ball and Padikkal looks to power this down the ground. Can't get power or elevation behind that and it goes to Rana who was backtracking to adjust and it pops out of his hands as he is falling back and he pops out one hand and it pops out again before he falls forward and holds it between his hands and body
Full and wide, just past the tramline! Umpire calls for wide

David sways out of the way quickly as Archer fires in another rocket around off. David goes over quickly to the bowler and the two share a quick laugh. They were team-mates at MI Cape Town in the 2022-23 season

Short outside off, beats David all ends up as he has a swipe at it. Called wide, but Royals review. David is crouching slightly, so the umpire asks for ball-tracking to compare it with David's height while standing upright at the crease. And looks like it's not wide, but just 0.02metres!
Pushes out this full ball outside off to mid-off
Slashed over the keeper! Short and wide and David throws his bat at this. Gets a thick edge that flies over
Beaten first up! On a length outside off, it jags away to beat the attempted drive

Kohli spoons a catch to cover! This is on a length outside off and Kohli looks to go inside out. Skies it in the end and Rana holds on to the catch. That came off the sticker of the bat! First time that Archer gets Kohli in T20s!

Pumped down the ground! And Padikkal carries on his sublime form against Rajasthan Royals! This is a full toss outside off and Padikkal lofts it downtown. And this is another very meaningful partnership between these two, against this team!
In the air and lands safe! Length ball angling in from around off, Kohli looks to play that flick again but miscues it. But it doesn't carry to deep square leg
Short and wide, Kohli looks to ramp and it's called wide again. And two bouncers for the over
Lofted over deep midwicket! This is in the slot around off and Kohli uses those powerful wrists of his to whip this away. Archer was running to his right but he stood no chance
Yorker around middle, Padikkal looks to swing it away and gets it out to deep backward square off the inside half
Deshpande sees Padikkal backing away and follows him with a short delivery. But it's quite high and evades Padikkal's attempted ramp. Umpire calls it wide
Good comeback from the bowler. Bowls it right in the block hole and Padikkal just blocks it out
Slashed away all the way! Short ball angled across, Padikkal reaches out and cuts it up and over short third

On a length outside off, Kohli looks to work it leg side and gets an inside edge onto his pads that deflects to Parag's left. Parag goes and collects and throws the stumps down at the striker's end. Thankfully the batters had already decided against a risky single
Kohli gets his first six now! Tossed up and given width, Kohli gets low and frees his arms to launch this over long-off
ON a length around off, 106kph, Padikkal looks to cut and it goes off the keeper towards square leg
Tossed full around middle and leg, Kohli looks to sweep and gets it off the inside edge towards square leg

Parag almost gets the better of Padikkal! He was coming down the crease again and Parag tossed it up very wide, and it was spinning away. Padikkal slashes at it and manages a thick enough edge for it to lob behind the keeper
And we have the first six of the day! Dances down the ground to this slot ball and lofts it over long-off

Tucks this length ball in the vacant midwicket region and they race for two. Hasaranga runs to his right to collect and throw it at the non-striker's end but by the time the ball gets to the fielder backing up, Padikkal is in safe
Dropped! Padikkal wanted to slog sweep this full ball around leg and gets a top edge. Tushar Deshpande running in from deep backward square can't hold on as he dives forward
Short-ish outside off, Kohli stays back and pulls it wide of long-on
Wrong'un outside leg, tucked through midwicket
Cleverly played by DDP! This is on a length around off and it spins away. Padikkal had backed away and just adjusts to punch it in the gap between point and short third
Floated up outside off, Kohli looks to bring out the slog sweep, but it goes off the bottom half of the bat through square leg
Pumped down the ground! This is very full around middle and leg and Padikkal is able to hammer this straight of long-off
Full around middle, clipped towards wide long-on
Edged for four! And that's a 60th IPL fifty for Virat KohlI! Pushes at this length ball outside off and gets a thick edge past the keeper. Raises his bat to acknowledge the applause
Slashed over short third! Kohli backs away to this length ball just outside off and drives hard at it. Thick edge goes well over the infielder
Yorker on leg, whipped out to deep midwicket
Short outside off, Kohli pulls it along the ground to deep midwicket
Tucks this legbreak on a length around off to long-on
On a length on leg, spinning away. Padikkal goes back to punch it out towards long-on
Legbreak outside leg, slides down for a wide
Wrong'un outside leg, Padikkal looks to paddle and it comes off the top edge. Farooqi gives chase to stop a boundary
Legbreak, on a length outside off and spinning away, Kohli cuts it away to deep point's left
Googly pitching on off and going across, Padikkal swipes it out to deep midwicket
Swept away in the gap!
makes a lot of room and Parag targets the stumps, whipped to the leg side for one

quick and flat again, but loses his line for a wide down leg past the sweep. Royals have reviewed that wide now, let's see if it had something. UltraEdge says there's a murmur when it's close to the glove, so not a wide, and the ball went on to hit Jurel's pad, the catch was not taken. It was hardly a catch to be honest
fired into leg stump and he defends this time

79.9kmh, really slow around outside leg, not much turn and Padikkal has enough time to rock back, open up and pull that away behind square to just beat the sliding Archer for four. Padikkal's first boundary
fires this one into the pads and Kohli is hurried to work this off his pads for one more
clipped off the pads with soft hands and that looked deliberate so that they could come back for the second
some width outside off, some turn and it's pushed wide of point for one

more work at the boundary line as Kohli flicks that full delivery off his toes nicely and calls for two immediately. This time Hetmyer with the slide to his left from deep midwicket and they return for the second
way outside off this time and he has to reach out for it for a single to deep cover
the ball stops a little before reaching Padikkal, and he defends the stifling delivery back
85.2kmh, slow legbreak with some turn after pitching just outside off, Kohli slaps it back and that's a great sliding effort from Jaiswal running to his left from long on to save three
slow and outside off, Padikkal waits before pulling that down to long-on
beats him to end the over too. Slides that one quick down off at 101.9kmh, and he pokes and misses
he makes some room for the length ball on the stumps and scythes it square for one
goes back again for the ball outside off, good bounce but he gets a single to long off
goes back for the cut and misses that one
short on off, some turn on offer but pulled away for four! It wasn't slow but Kohli rocked back in no time and swatted that away
pushes that one with the turn down to long-off for one
gently taps that length ball towards mid-on and Hasaranga throws himself to his right to save the single
rocks back first ball and tucks that with the turn to leg. Off the mark

skied to deep midwicket and Salt has run out of luck! Pitched up without much pace and swept against the turn for a leading edge that sends the ball into the night sky before it lands in Hetmyer's hands well inside the rope
fuller outside off and driven towards cover boundary but the fielder in the circle does well to stop it with a dive
legbreak on middle for Kohli, and it's short enough for him to rock back and help to long on
starts with a googly on the stumps, worked to the leg side easily for one
another yorker for Salt and he digs it out to long-on for one more. Keeps strike after the powerplay
makes room early to dab that short of length ball wide of short third but Archer does well to dive to his left and save three
a half-volley served on a platter and Kohli gobbles that down in one go! Too straight, too full, and driven back straight with lovely timing and touch for four
in the block hole now, Salt keeps an open stance and bunts that down with some power, for a quick single to mid-off
full on the stumps, bashed down along the ground but straight to mid-off
short of length into the body and Kohli chips it wide of midwicket for one
wider outside off and a touch shorter too, Kohli runs it down to deep point for one
137.4kmh, much better length delivery shaping away around off and a watchful Kohli defends to off
flicked wide of mid-on and the crowd roars as soon as the ball leaves the 30-yard circle! Too full, swinging into middle and leg, and Kohli is going to flick those in his sleep
into the batter this time and he clips it square for one
through the covers and four more! A length ball outside off but this has room and Salt can drive it away through the covers for a boundary
he wants a yorker first ball, but it's a slow and low full toss on middle and Salt connects with that nicely to send that straight back past mid-on for four
136kmh, low and dipping full toss on off and it's driven to mid-off before Salt hares across for one

top-edge sails over short third for a one-bounce four! Salt and RCB are riding their luck here, and maybe that's what they need to finally win at home. Short ball into the pitch, only a leading edge off the pull and that goes straight over short third for four
takes the pace off, this one's at 109.5kmh outside off and Kohli pushes it towards mid-off for one

lands short of deep midwicket. There are two fielders in the deep on leg for the short ball, and Farooqi does bang it in short. Salt middles this pull and had he hit it a little shorter, that would have reached Hetmyer
136.6kmh, on the leg side and flicked away off the pads square of the wicket for one
132.1kmh, length ball on middle and leg, and Salt taps it down to mid-off to pinch a single
pulled wide of square leg for four. Two in a row! Short and into the body, he only wants to connect with that nicely with timing, doesn't pack much punch into that and sends it wide of square leg

inside edge for four! More drama as the ball jags back in from outside off and takes the inside edge without no footwork at all from Kohli, and deep fine leg gives up early on the chase which Archer doesn't like at all
shorter and outside off at 146.8kmh, it's the pace and bounce that beats Kohli again. Into the pitch, rising high and over Kohli's swinging bat
pulled in the air on the swivel because he has mistimed that pull behind square, but that landed halfway before deep fine leg. One more
145.1kmh, short and into the body, perhaps didn't bounce as much as Kohli expected but he gets enough on the pull for a single wide of square leg
149.1kmh, back of length outside off, no room and he defends towards cover
almost a yorker, perhaps an inch short and Salt bunts that back with timing, not so much with power and beats the diving mid-on for four!
a near-yorker again, this time Salt keeps it along the ground completely and drives gently to mid-off
swinging away from outside off, he pokes away from the body for a single to deep third
shorter and on middle and leg, clipped square this time for one

dropped at mid-off! Another attempted yorker, Salt chips this low full toss straight down the ground to mid-off where captain Parag goes low to his right, catches the ball but can't hold on when his hands hit the ground on the tumble
down the leg side and that's the second wide already. He was interestingly attempting a yorker, and the length was not that bad but the line was down leg with some inswing
134.7kmh, he beats Salt first ball as well. On length on middle and angling away outside off, chases and misses
beats him like he had beaten Salt. Short and outside off, past the punching attempt with the extra bounce and into the keeper's gloves in no time after leaving the hand at 150.1kmh

just beyond the reach of first slip and four! What an over this has been, this one at 148.5kmh, short outside off and Kohli gets a very thick outside edge while trying to scythe that away and luckily for him it beats first slip

bounces over Kohli, bounces over the keeper and gone for four! That was 149.8kmh! Short and quick, right into the pitch, Kohli lets it go over him while withdrawing his pull and the ball sails over Jurel
short and coming in, bit more to the leg side now and Salt swivels to help it along to fine leg
beaten again! Stays still this time for the short of length ball outside off, Salt wants to punch it away but the extra bounce beats him
goes over the stumps! Salt walks across to off to flay the ball with the swing to the leg side but he doesn't connect at all
swinging in at a pace of 145.1kmh! Salt barely has the time to move much but does well to defend it back
he bangs it in short, as expected, but it's gone down leg for a wide

Clubbed down the ground and just short of long-off. RCB have pulled off a comeback win for the ages! Josh Hazlewood the hero and Kohli knows it as he lifts the Australian off his feet. RR fall short in another chase they were in control of! What scenes at the Chinnaswamy!
Full toss outside off, inside edge onto the ground and towards Jitesh's left, who collects and has a shy at the striker's end but misses
Yorker around middle, dug out towards long-on. And that should mathematically seal the win. Huge cheers around the Chinnaswamy! Their team has won a game here!

Drilled down the ground to long-off and there's a run-out chance. The throw at the striker's end comes high and wide to Jitesh, who does well to collect and stretch to the stumps with his right hand. Looks so close with the bails lit up with Hasaranga's bat on the line. The umpire decides there isn't anything that's crossed the crease, And Hasaranga has to go!
Gets the yorker through! Deshpande can't jam his bat down on time, but RR get the bye away. The ball just went past off stump as well

Full toss and he hits it straight to deep midwicket! Low full toss just outside off and Shubham Dubey picks out Phil Salt. The crowd is going crazy as RCB close in on their first home win of the season!

Hasaranga slices at this length ball outside off, and it goes on the bounce to deep third who is standing very fine! They don't take the run. 17 needed off the last over! Seven runs and three wickets in Hazlewood's final two overs today. Absolutely stunning!
Brute from Hazlewood! Back of length around off, Hasasranga backs away and pushes at it but he's beaten on the outside edge!

Two in two for Hazlewood! Back of length outside off, Archer looks to go inside out and there's no foot movement and he ends up slicing it up to cover's left. Patidar makes no mistake and Archer is disgusted with himself! RCB right back in this! What twists and turns over the last two-three overs!

Jurel backs away to make room and Hazlewood nails the wide yorker! The ball sneaks past as Jurel brings his bat down. And hold on, RCB have reviewed for caught-behind! Was there a thin bottom edge as Jurel brought the bat down? There is a spike as the ball crosses bat! They will do a check now for a bump ball. No, no bounce, Jurel is gone three short of a fifty! Hazlewood has got a third! What an appeal from Jitesh Sharma there! Jitesh has been excellent with his judgement behind the stumps this season, when it's come to reviews.
Dug in short outside off, Jurel can only bottom-edge this pull to midwicket
Full toss angled across him, Dubey looks to go down the ground and slices it between cover and point!
Scooped behind for four more! Jurel moves across and gets this over the keeper. What a big over! Has changed the game for Rajasthan Royals!
Oh poor fielding! Jurel just dabs this length ball fine on the off side and Hazlewood is slow to move to his left and stop it

It's all happening! Yorker on the stumps, dug out towards mid-off. Patidar has a shy at the non-striker's end as Jurel is sent back and misses the stumps. Batter was comfortably in and the overthrow allows an extra run
Pulled away! This short ball on leg sits up nicely and Dubey helps it along over square leg!
Short outside off, Jurel looks to swat this down the ground again but gets it off the top edge. Bounces well short of long-on running in.
Creaaaammmed down the ground! Bhuvneshwar starts off with a slot ball outside off, and Jurel lofts it down the ground! Just the start RR needed to this over!
What a drive! Length ball angled across and Dubey drives this on the up and perfectly picks the gap between cover and mid-off!
Hazlewood rushes Dubey with a length ball on middle and leg. He looks to pull it but it's off the splice and drops short of midwickete
Dubey looks to drive this length ball outside off, mistimes it to cover. That length wasn't there to be driven!

Has he nicked that? The umpire reckons he has! Beautiful from Hazlewood! It's back of length around leg, cramping Hetmyer, who plays all around it, trying to whip it leg side. Gets an inside edge and Hazlewood has done it again for RCB!

Sliced to backward point's right. Kohli is quick to it and juuust misses his throw at the non-striker's end. This was on a length outside off and Jurel looked to cut. Falls short of the fielder too. The batters did well to rush the single
Back of length outside off, Jurel can only punch it out to cover
Starts off with a short ball that slides down leg, even with Jurel moving leg side

On a length on leg, tucked out towards deep square leg. They go for two and the throw comes in at the striker's end. Hetmyer put in the dive and it looks like he's safe. And indeed he is. There was some hesitation on whether they should run the second that created that half-chance for RCB
On a length around leg, tucked past the short fine leg fielder. They scamper for two and get there comfortably
On a length around off, coming in with the angle, Jurel works it down the ground to long-on
Into the stands! Jurel is now taking on the bowling. This isn't a long hop, but Jurel takes it on anyway, pulling it away over midwicket for a 90-metre six!
Full around off, driven out to cover
On a length outside off, Hetmyer gets down to sweep. It lobs up off him to short fine leg's left. They can't get a single
Jurel breaks free! This is shorter and on the stumps and Jurel rocks back and pulls this in front of square for a flat six. Oh he needed that, and so did RR. Still, just eight off the over
Beats him! Legbreak outside off again, on a length. Jurel slashed at it and got nothing on it
Legbreak outside off on a length, Jurel cuts it straight to the backward point fielder
Wrong'un outside off, punched out to deep cover
On a length just outside off, punched down the ground to long-on
103kph, on a length just outside off, Jurel blocks it towards cover
On a length outside leg, Hetmyer just gets enough bat on it to glance it past the keeper and it's too fine for short fine leg and Hetmyer picks up a much-needed boundary for Royals
Full toss around leg, Jurel sweeps it out to deep backward square
On a length and angled across him, Hetmyer eases it in front of point

Rana picks out short fine leg! Krunal bowls this on a length on leg, Rana looks for the sweep but hits this straight to Bhuvneshwar. Was above his head height and he puts up his hands to grab it. Ends up parrying it in the air and takes it at the second go. The pressure tells! The new ball also helps RCB!
Looks to swipe away this length abll going across and he misses. Bounces off the keeper's gloves behind him for an extra run as well
Krunal follows Jurel, wjho was looking to make room. Punched to mid-off
Tossed up on off, Jurel finds the cover fielder with his drive

Chance for Jitesh! Big edge from Jurel as he looks to cut this 104kph legbreak outside off. Lobs off Jitesh's gloves to his right. Quiet over again from Suyash, although it could have brought a wicket
Rana looks to heave it away but can't time or middle it. Miscues a pull that lands short of long-on running in. This wasn't quite short enough for the pull
On a length and this comes in with the angle from outside off. Rana, cramped for room, punches it to extra cover
Legbreak outside off, Jurel cuts it away to deep point's left
Tossed on a length outside off, Jurel blocks it back to the bowler
A bit short outside off, Rana rocks back and slaps it away to the off side sweeper
Darted in on length, Rana stays back and clips it out to deep midwicket
On a length around middle and off, dropped in front of square leg for a quick run
Nails the reverse-sweep! Got in position early and sends this full ball outside off over short third
Tossed up on middle at 90kph, Jurel meets it with the full face
Tucks this length ball off his pads to deep midwicket
On a length around middle and leg, Jurel goes back and tucks it towards long-on
Legbreak outside off, cut away to deep point
On a length around off, tucked in the gap at midwicket. They take it a little easy on the running and get just a single
Tossed up fuller outside off, Jurel eases a drive to long-off
ANother ball on a length outside off, cut away again behind point. Two more for RR
Legbreak on a length outside off again, Jurel cuts it to deep point's left and the batters have enough time to run two
Suyash fires it in at 102kph on a length and Jurel is beaten on the cut
pushes the length ball to long on for one
on the stumps again, this time Jurel middles it back

two wickets in four balls! Krunal with the golden arm, but Jurel has reviewed it immediately. Wicket denied because UltraEdge says there's a spike for the inside edge after Krunal had fired it in towards the stumps and he though he had him lbw
short, flat and angling away, pulled wide of long-on and they think of a second but settle for one
makes room first ball and punches that through cover. Off the mark

he strikes first ball and we do have a crowd here at the Chinnaswamy! Big sweep against the turn first ball, goes up a mile close to the pitch and Jitesh, with his gloves, under the helmet, moves towards short midwicket and pouches it. Krunal has his finger up but no send off or word spoken
pushes the last ball into the covers and they decide against the run eventually just in time

136.4kmh, and one more! Not as much power as the last delivery but this time the ball has pace and Rana smartly uses that with some timing to punch that through the covers without much of a follow through. Bethell runs and runs but he's beaten again
not this time! Slower wobbly seam, a lot fuller and this time he dispatches that over the covers, well wide of Superman Bethell for four

excellent fielding effort in the deep but has he done it neatly? Rana slammed that slower and short ball into the off side and Jacob Bethell sprinted for his life to his left, put in a dive and extended his left arm to grab the ball running away, and even pushing it back just in time
136.2kmh, pace to Rana who gently taps the full ball to cover
107.3kmh, starts with a slower one angling across, Parag waits and slams it through the covers
flat again, but wide, and Parag cuts it away nicely to deep point
quick, flat and straight this time. And he blocks it back
much quicker at 101.4kmh, and the pace beats Parag but the luck continues to be with the Royals. Thick edge off the bat, fine on the off side for four and Suyash has his hands on the knees
wants to work it to leg, only gets an snide edge onto his pad
hello there, Suyash! Welcome to the show. Parag gets under the full delivery on middle and leg and smashes that into the sky, over deep square leg and all the way
loopy lebreak drifting in from wide outside off, the low full toss is driven into the covers for one

135.6kmh, leading edge for six over the keeper this time. All Shepherd can do is smile and take his cap from the umpire. A mighty pull for the short ball, and it was the bat speed that resulted in the ball flying off the bat all the way
big swing for the ball outside off, toe end of the bat and that's raced fine on the off side for four! Raining boundaries in Luru tonight
pushes this length delivery into the covers for one
on the pads now, he's not able to tickle that fine and it becomes a dot
but room this time, even if a hint of it, with the angle, and Rana flays that away with a rampish cut wide of deep third for four
134.3kmh, no room to start with and on back of a length, Rana defends it back
139.8kmh, stays back and defends the short of length ball around off

and Hazlewood has avenged himself, he'll think. He gets the reward of persisting with the short length, this one climbs on Jaiswal for the pull which he doesn't middle this time and hands a simple catch to the midwicket fielder coming in
ramped all the way! Jaiswal is on fire and he's unstoppable. Really short, just outside off, hardly any body movement from Jaiswal before he extends his arms for the ramp and middles this one too
over the infield this time and the same result. Pitched up this time, and Jaiswal gets under it nicely to time it over the covers instead of bashing it away like he did on the previous delivery
crached to the point boundary. That raced away in a flash and the crowd has been silenced again. Hint of with, Jaiswal goes after it with some power and middles it wide of point
bounce again for Hazlewood. Short of length outside off, takes off and goes over the fierce cut from Jaiswal
some movement off the pitch away from Rana, he's surprised and pushes to cover
two dots are enough, Rana takes off as well! Just short on middle stump and Rana hardly moves his feet, relying only his hand-eye coordnation for that swivel and it's sailed all the way behind square
patient again and defends the length ball from off back to the bowler
waits for the ball outside off and patiently dabs towards short third
middle stump gone and the crowd is awake! Not a short ball for a change, it's on length towards the stumps and the teenager swings wildly and misses

he has skied that, it's gone to the moon and come back, and much to the crowd's dismay it lands close to them and in the RR dugout. He pulled that short of length ball towards the body and got a leading edge that went really high and behind him for six

three fours in a row! It's the length that's become predictable and working in Jaiswal's favour. Short again, this time on leg, and he only has to time that pull properly to clear the infield. Four more
on the other side and four more! Gets a hint of width this time for the off side and he flays that over the covers confidently
just over midwicket. Like Salt, Jaiswal still has his luck going. He pulls to leg and the ball goes just over the leaping fielder in the circle
three strikes in a row. Stifling line on middle and leg, he swings but misses again

Jaiswal has been floored! Literally. At 138.6kmh, into the pitch, a mean bouncer that Jaiswal wants to ramp away without moving his feet but the line is such, it goes over him while Jaiswal arches back all the way and loses his balance
charges first ball down thet track, Hazlewood pitches it short and outside leg, and the batter is stifled and misses the pull
and a bouncer to end the over, he looks to smash it away but misses. It's the extra bounce that beat him
another short ball, another pull, not quite off the middle this time and it's easily cleared the infield to get two more
follows the bouncer with a yorker on the stumps and he bunts it down to mid off
he bangs in a bouncer at 134.9kmh, not as quick as Archer but the ball has enough bounce to make the batter leave it alone above the stumps
into the crowd, and they don't want to catch that, they don't want to see these sixes! Short and coming in, he swings with all his might and sends that crashing over the midwicket boundary
in the block hole to start the over and he defends it back
that's gone to Cubbon Park! Well, almost. The way he had middled that, it deserved to go for a walk. Slightly short, Jaiswal gets on top of it and smashes the bones out of it with a pull
more luck for Jaiswal! Another leading edge, another leaping fielder, and another one falls safe as it goes over a jumping Krunal at cover point
BOOM! Pitched up on the stumps and it's hammered back straight past the bowler into the boundary. Pin drop silence at the ground

just over a leaping short third for four! Jaiswal never looked in control of that, again trying to flick to leg, perhaps for the inswing but the ball takes the leading outside edge and flies over the fielder in the circle
swings the bat with the inswing, from bottom to top like he does but he's not middling them tonight. Still clears midwicket for one
swings this one down leg a bit too much, and a wide. Excellent take by Jitesh, and if it was allowed DK would have come running out to high-five him
ooh, lovely inswinging yorker at the base of middle and leg, and Suryavanshi does well to block it out
some bounce to end the over and Jaiswal is not able to get on top of it easily, pushes to cover
wants to go inside out but doesn't middle it again, slices it in the air towards deep third for one
goes for a big shot on the leg side, he only gets an edge onto his body before it goes behind
want to flick to leg but gets a leading edge and luckily for him well over cover point for one
a length delivery on the leg side and he defends respectfully this time
fetch that! Short ball to start with, like RR did, but this one doesn't have as much pace and Jaiswal have smoked that one out of the screws into the stands on the leg side. Smokin'!
